def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts={v:[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==v] for v in range(10)}
    bg=max(range(10), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    colors=[v for v in range(10) if v!=bg and pts[v]]
    # Continue the two diagonal strokes visible in the motif, away from the endpoint cluster.
    for v in colors:
        p=pts[v]
        # choose dominant unit diagonal direction from pairs
        dirs=[]
        for r,c in p:
            for rr,cc in p:
                if (r,c)!=(rr,cc) and abs(r-rr)==abs(c-cc):
                    dirs.append((1 if rr>r else -1, 1 if cc>c else -1))
        # use line direction inferred from most frequent adjacent diagonal pairs
        if not dirs: continue
        from collections import Counter
        dr,dc=Counter(dirs).most_common(1)[0][0]
        # extend both ends of the longest diagonal run
        runs=[]
        for r,c in p:
            # only start if predecessor absent
            if (r-dr,c-dc) not in p:
                line=[];a,b=r,c
                while (a,b) in p:
                    line.append((a,b));a+=dr;b+=dc
                runs.append(line)
        if not runs: continue
        line=max(runs,key=len)
        for r,c,step in [(line[0][0],line[0][1],-1),(line[-1][0],line[-1][1],1)]:
            r+=step*dr;c+=step*dc
            while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c] in (bg,v):
                out[r][c]=v;r+=step*dr;c+=step*dc
    return out
PY
